cross_references.relationship: Concluding mighty-hand recollection and sea-deliverance witness
cross_references.rationale: The conclusion recalls mighty action before Israel; the sea account specifically says Israel saw the Lord's great hand, was rescued and trusted God and Moses, without making Moses the ultimate source of power.

target_verses.text: The Lord rescued Israel that day from the Egyptians’ hand, and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.
Israel saw the great hand in what the Lord had done to the Egyptians. The people feared the Lord and trusted God and His attendant Moses.
